HeatmapLegend.description:
How to read vertex colors on the heatmap GLB.

The GLB is in the base scan's frame, in meters, with these colors already applied.
The scale is signed, not a magnitude ramp from unchanged to large change:
blue is a dent (negative), gray is inside the neutral band around zero, and red is added material (positive).

min_mm.description: Low end of the color scale, millimeters of signed change from the base surface. Negative is a dent.
min_mm.title: Min Mm

max_mm.description: High end of the color scale, millimeters of signed change from the base surface. Positive is added material.
max_mm.title: Max Mm

threshold_mm.description: Comparison threshold, millimeters from the base surface. Matches stats.threshold_mm.
threshold_mm.title: Threshold Mm

colormap.description: Signed scale baked into the heatmap GLB vertex colors. Blue is a dent, gray is within neutral_band_mm of zero, red is added material. Not a blue-to-red magnitude ramp.
colormap.title: Colormap

neutral_band_mm.description: Half-width of the gray band around zero, millimeters. Equal to threshold_mm.
neutral_band_mm.title: Neutral Band Mm

counts.title: Counts

UncoveredRegion.description:
Surface that only one of the two scans captured, so it cannot be compared.

`centroid_m` and `radius_m` match Region, so a marker can be placed and sized.

area_cm2.description: Uncovered area on that scan, square centimeters.
area_cm2.title: Area Cm2

centroid_m.description: Centroid [x, y, z] in the base scan frame, meters.
centroid_m.title: Centroid M

radius_m.description: Max distance from centroid_m to any point in the uncovered patch, meters, in the base scan frame.
radius_m.title: Radius M

description:
Comparison of a new scan against a base scan, for the web viewer.

All three GLBs are in the base scan frame, in meters, with +Y up as in ARKit and glTF. Every
position in this response (centroid_m, bbox_*_m) is in that frame too. The upload is USDZ, which
three.js cannot load, so the engine publishes both scans as GLB. `new_model_url` is already aligned
into the base frame. `heatmap_url` is the base surface with vertex colors already applied on the
signed blue/gray/red scale.

is_mock.description: True when this is the engine's fixed example response, not a comparison of the two scans.
is_mock.title: Is Mock

heatmap_url.description: Heatmap GLB in the base scan frame, meters, with signed blue/gray/red vertex colors already applied.
heatmap_url.title: Heatmap Url

base_model_url.description: Base scan as GLB, in the base scan frame, meters. No heatmap colors.
base_model_url.title: Base Model Url

new_model_url.description: New scan as GLB, aligned into the base scan frame, meters. No heatmap colors.
new_model_url.title: New Model Url

verdict_confidence.description: Unitless confidence in the verdict, from 0 to 1.
verdict_confidence.title: Verdict Confidence
